scope: Author-run packaged app in a disposable macOS 27 guest: live HUD during real takes, the menu picker and Settings → Modes in Light and Dark; local recognizer and a synthetic loopback refinement endpoint; not recognition or model quality.

method.input: macvm clicks and arrow keys; native microphone consent; System Settings appearance controls
method.takes: cantrip start --postproc MODE; samples/jfk.wav played twice into BlackHole 2ch; cantrip stop
method.capture: guest screencapture each 0.2–0.5 s beside cantrip status --json stage; crops cut to the HUD's one-point frame
method.stt: local Parakeet v3 (parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8) in the guest
method.llm_endpoint: http://openrouter.ai:9900/v1, with openrouter.ai mapped to 127.0.0.1 and ::1 in the guest's /etc/hosts
method.llm_provider: synthetic OpenAI-compatible endpoint on loopback; seven-second delay; fixed public sentence per mode; logs route, host, model and mode only

contrast.method: WCAG ratio of each element's strongest-contrast pixel against its background, on the live captures

found_and_fixed: macOS 27 status menus draw no NSMenuItem images (SF Symbol, bitmap or drawn); the glyph now rides in the title as a text attachment
Details open pushed Save & Apply under the Dock at 1440x900; recognizer row dropped, Details rows 8 pt apart, instructions 50 pt
AppKit disclosure triangle 1.84:1 and borderless Details title 4.00:1 in Light; one borderless toggle in the label color

after_proof.change: on macOS the take line's promise, stage at work and destination are fitted in lightness until their most covered painted pixel reads at 4.5:1
after_proof.test: hud::tests::the_take_line_reads_at_4_5_to_1_as_painted, AppKit Light and Dark palettes at 1x

not_proven: menu tooltips (no hover in macvm; unit-tested text)
a live Linux take (Linux HUD states are layer-surface fixtures under headless sway; Settings rendered with Details closed)
